questions.q: Slope is calculated as the:
o: change in the vertical variable divided by the change in the horizontal variable.
change in the horizontal variable divided by the change in the vertical variable.

questions.q: If the price elasticity of demand for any good is inelastic, which of the following could be a possible value of the elasticity?
questions.why: المرونة تقيس مدى استجابة الكمية لتغير السعر أو الدخل؛ نقسم نسبة تغير الكمية على نسبة تغير العامل المؤثر.
questions.tip: Elastic: السعر ↑ الإيراد ↓. Inelastic: السعر ↑ الإيراد ↑. مرونة أكبر من 1 = Elastic.

o: marginal cost is greater than average total cost.
marginal cost equals average total cost.
